purpose: Repo-local OS Abyss artifact bundle input for generated/release_manifest.json.

consumer_contract.stable_interface: python scripts/validation/validate_abyss_machine_artifact_bundle.py --repo-root . and abyss-machine artifacts trust-gate --artifact-class aoa_skills_release_manifest --consumer-intent agent --json
consumer_contract.consumer_expectation: Skill export consumers select an aoa_skills_release_manifest bundle from the registry latest read-model only after ABI verification, release-manifest subject materialization, and consumer trust-gate allow/warn succeeds.

consumer_command: abyss-machine artifacts bundle-register BUNDLE_DIR --registry-dir REGISTRY_DIR --lifecycle-state release-ready --consumer-ref aoa-skills:release-manifest --source-repo aoa-skills --json

abyss-machine artifacts materialize-subjects BUNDLE_DIR --registry-dir REGISTRY_DIR --manifest mechanics/release-support/manifests/release_manifest.bundle.json --consumer-intent agent --source-repo aoa-skills --json
abyss-machine artifacts trust-gate --registry-dir REGISTRY_DIR --artifact-class aoa_skills_release_manifest --consumer-intent agent --source-repo aoa-skills --subject-digest SUBJECT_DIGEST --json
abyss-machine artifacts registry-latest --registry-dir REGISTRY_DIR --artifact-class aoa_skills_release_manifest --source-repo aoa-skills --json
